title: Euler buckling of a clamped–free column of solids
source: Euler's column with Engesser's shear correction P = P_e/(1 + P_e/(κ G A)), κ = 5/6 (S. P. Timoshenko, J. M. Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, 2nd ed., McGraw-Hill 1961, §2.1, §2.17): square section 1 × 1, E = 1000, ν = 0, length 10 clamped–free, effective length 20, P_e = π² E I/20², so σ_cr = P/A = 2.046071
